# IGRYbuilds

> Premium websites and smart automation for local businesses, built by hand in Rajasthan, India.

## About

- **Name:** IGRYbuilds
- **What:** A founder-led studio helping local businesses win more customers through premium websites and smart automation (enquiry handling, follow-ups, WhatsApp automation).
- **Founder:** Manmohan Sharma
- **Founded:** March 2026
- **Based in:** Ratangarh, Rajasthan 331802, India
- **Serves:** Rajasthan, India
- **Site:** https://igrybuilds.pages.dev/

## Services

- [Premium Websites](https://igrybuilds.pages.dev/services/websites.html): Web design in India for businesses that want more than a brochure site — designed and built from scratch to turn visitors into customers.
- [Website Redesign & CRO](https://igrybuilds.pages.dev/services/redesign.html): Redesign and conversion-rate optimisation that turn existing visitors into customers, without starting from scratch.
- [Local SEO](https://igrybuilds.pages.dev/services/seo.html): Google Maps optimisation, local search and reviews, built for Rajasthan businesses.
- [Business Automation](https://igrybuilds.pages.dev/services/automation.html): Enquiry handling, follow-ups, bookings and workflows that run themselves — deletes busywork.
- [AI Chatbots](https://igrybuilds.pages.dev/services/chatbots.html): An AI chatbot and AI receptionist for the business — every question answered instantly, trained on the business, working 24/7.
- [WhatsApp Systems](https://igrybuilds.pages.dev/services/whatsapp.html): Enquiry flows, instant follow-ups and booking reminders that stop leads going cold.

## Pricing

Open, fixed pricing — the quote agreed is the price paid, no hidden extras:
